w: Salta's cathedral holds two crowned images: Christ as the 'Lord of Miracles' and the Virgin as 'Our Lady of the Miraculous Rosary,' both granted a Pontifical coronation decree by Pope Leo XIII in 1899 and crowned in 1902. The building opened to the public in 1918, and was declared a national monument in 1941.
s: Cathedral of two Pope-crowned holy images

w: Built to house the Children of Llullaillaco - three Inca mummies found in 1999 near the Llullaillaco volcano's summit - this museum opened in 2004 but took until 2007 to perfect a system to preserve them. It later added the Teruel collection (2005) and the 'Reina del Cerro' mummy, from a sanctuary looted in the 1920s.
s: Museum built around Inca child mummies
